# Portuguese voice commands. Most lines are from the vendor's published Portuguese command list (used as a coverage checklist);
# lines the list lacks, or leaves in English, were translated for this project and have NOT been reviewed by a native speaker.
# Two vendor lines have typos (an "alarque" and a timer-cancel written as "alarme"); the fixture uses the corrected "cronômetro".
# Format: English => Portuguese. {braces} mark the variable part; tests remove the braces.

What's this? => O que é?
What can you see? => O que você consegue ver?
